caseNameFull: Samuels v. Mackell, District Attorney of Queens County and Fernandez v. Mackell, District Attorney of Queens County
attorneys: Victor Rabinowitz for Samuels et al. in No. 580, and Eleanor Jackson Piel for Fernandez in No. 813, on the motion.

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. S. D. N. Y. [Probable jurisdiction noted, ante, p. 975.] Joint motion of appellants to enlarge time for oral argument of these consolidated cases granted, and 15 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Counsel for appellees likewise allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
